about: Keying & Time page stills: compare pairs (--pairs) and preset strips (--presets). node scripts/effect-lab.mjs --pairs scripts/effect-lab-shots/keying-time.json --only <name>; node scripts/effect-lab.mjs --presets scripts/effect-lab-shots/keying-time.json --only <effect id>

pairs.name: chroma-key
pairs.alt: A dancer leaping in front of an unevenly lit green screen, with curly hair and a chiffon scarf, original left and keyed with Chroma Key right over a dark blue background: the green is gone, the flyaway hair keeps its detail without a green rim and the scarf stays see-through
pairs.caption: Left: original. Right: Chroma Key at its default settings, over dark blue.

pairs.name: chroma-key-matte
pairs.alt: The green-screen frame in View Matte at default settings: the screen is black, the leaping dancer white with a grey see-through scarf; thin white curtain edges stand at the left and right and white specks sit in the lower corners
pairs.caption: View → Matte: black is keyed away, white stays, grey is see-through. The curtain edges are no screen colour, so they stay.
